gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-hind-vadodara: Commanding Wallpoet headings come with high-rising lowercase and gaps where the paper shows through. Hind Vadodara carries a long paragraph smoothly, its sans-serif strokes uniform and its rounded glyphs open at the ends.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-huninn: Huninn, a plain sans, lets its s terminals hang free. Wallpoet heads the pair in bold, commanding display letters, high lowercase and paper-showing lines against Huninn's crossbars as fat as its stems.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-karla: Wallpoet is best when shouting, with smooth bends and lowercase that climbs high. Karla does the quieter work, its gaping c opening and deep middle band making lines look stocky.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-khula: Text in this pair reads modern and unfussy, with curves that hold their mouths open. Khula, a sans with a squat brush-pen belly, quietly carries the sentences while Wallpoet does its best work bold and commanding up top.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-krub: Krub is a contemporary sans with a pronounced x-height. What stands out is the gap between smooth, high-rising, commanding Wallpoet and Krub's pen-lifted curves that leave each loop unfinished.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-michroma: Michroma reads wide and contemporary, each letter given a generous berth and the ascender tips kept stubby. Wallpoet does the shouting, bold and commanding, while that body stays quiet.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One is approachable, a sans with wide gaps between letters and a sizable lowercase body. Bold Wallpoet commands attention, while the body traces each letter in constant weight.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline is a sans whose lowercase looks oversized beside its capitals. Beside Wallpoet's smooth, high-rising display letters, its round bowls and breathing counters keep the page moving without competing.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mozilla-headline: Big-bodied and friendly: Mozilla Headline pairs a splayed c terminal with Wallpoet's smooth, commanding, high-rising display letters. Plain sans text here keeps moving, approachable and contemporary across a full page.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text is a sans-serif whose lowercase looks bold because the bodies are so large, with terminals that flare outward. Wallpoet's commanding display shapes meet that sturdy lowercase head-on, and neither backs down.
